findings.claim: test_briefing_has_three_parts checks routing with 'docs/' and '.okf/', but the rules part (audience-picks-the-folder) contains both strings, so the test passes when routing is missing. Assert a string only routing prints, such as 'Knowledge in this repository' or 'Verbs:'. Do not use 'Start at .okf/index.md', because the start-at-the-index rule prints it too.

WORD_BUDGET is defined, and the module docstring says the briefing stays within it, but no code reads it. test_briefing_word_budget hardcodes 600, so changing the constant changes nothing. The test should import and assert against WORD_BUDGET.
The state line prints '1 concepts due for review' when the count is 1.
